description:
This is a collection of short stories that depict the passion and romance of boy's love. Each couple go through different conflicts together that test their feelings for one another. A collection of boy's love webtoon ranging from romantic comedy to a murder mystery!

1-3. **Margaret Buinui Bimilgongbang** (마거릿 부인의 비밀공방, Lady Margaret's Secret Workshop) \[Eoreunyongsatang & Yulseo\]
Genius jeweller Jen works at Lady Margaret's Secret Workshop in exchange for “something” only the madame can offer. But what is that something...?

4-6. **Love and fever** (Love and fever, Love and fever) \[Yeoing\]
Hayoon asks his lover Junwoo to take of his shift at his part-time job, but Junwoo realizes what condition Hayoon is in and goes to visit him. As soon as the door opens... Hayoon is definitely in a strange state!

7-9. **Maid Yeonswae Sarinsageon** (메이드 연쇄 살인사건, Mass Maid Murderer) \[Gojo\]
In a world like 19th Century England, with no specified gender roles much like the real world, the age of the employee began, but there's a serial killer on the loose that only targets male maids! In order to solve the cases, Russel employs the maid Elliot...

10-12. **Dalkomsalbeolhan Geu Mueonga** (달콤살벌한 그 무언가, Sweet and Freaky/Sweet but Bloodly) \[Wangsaeuchyobap\]
Yoohan isn't family nor lover to Anjae, yet he provides him with warm food and a warm home. Anjae begins to slowly contemplate over his relationship with Yoohan...

13-15. **Nege Ppajin Jeom** (네게 빠진 점, Why I'm Into You/The Mark I Fell For) \[Lemi\]
Siyeon may be weak for beauties wih tear moles, but he's too weak when meeting with the perfectly ideal Eunha! What does he do? He can't stop thinking about Eunha!

16-20. **unfixable** (unfixable, unfixable) \[Innin\]
21-23. **Naega Iljiniya?** (내가 일진이야?, Am I the Bully?/I'm the Top Dog?) \[Kkomi & Etoe)
24-26. **Isanghyang** (이상향, The Perfect Scent/Aromatic Romance) \[Dona\]

(Source: INKR & Copin Comics)
